shortDescription: The DAX Index decreased 39 points or 0.15 percent on Tuesday to close at 25402 points.The decline was led by Zalando (-3.63%), Deutsche Bank (-2.37%) and Daimler Truck Holding AG (-1.82%).On the upside, the strongest performers were Rheinmetall (3.55%), Qiagen NV (1.81%) and RWE (1.64%).
